ai_summary:
- The 2026 FIFA World Cup is scheduled to take place in June–July 2026.  
- The opening match will kick off on **10 June 2026** and the final will be played on **10 July 2026**.  
- The tournament will be hosted jointly by the United States, Canada, and Mexico.  
- It will feature a record‑setting 48‑team format, expanding the competition from the current 32‑team structure.
